historical_claims.anchor: His fire captain, Beatty, comes to visit.
At the firehouse, Montag brings Beatty a book as instructed.
The broadcasters cannot allow the spectacle to end without an arrest.
Granger explains that the group is trying to preserve knowledge for a future in which people may once again want it.
